payload.title: Lazy loading with Xarray
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates the use of Xarray for lazy loading of large datasets, which helps manage memory usage by loading data in smaller chunks. It covers loading data via URLs using Xarray and handling cases where URLs do not work directly using Kerchunk. The notebook also includes visualization techniques for climate data, such as plotting surface maps and sections with scatter plots.
